arguments.command:
python3 -c "
import parse

# What if we have single digit hour/minute without leading zeros?
test_cases = [
    '10:21:36 +1:00',     # Single digit hour
    '10:21:36 +01:0',     # Single digit minute (unusual)
    '10:21:36 +1:30',     # Both single digit
]

for case in test_cases:
    r = parse.parse('{:tt}', case)
    if r:
        tz = r.fixed[0].tzinfo
        print(f'{case:25s} -> name={tz.tzname(None)!r}, offset={tz.utcoffset(None)}')
    else:
        print(f'{case:25s} -> No match')
"
